_how_to_switch: This one setting controls the whole site's season (app, guide pages, social posts). auto = summer mode from auto_summer_start to auto_summer_end (MM-DD), off-season the rest of the year. Change mode to "summer" or "offseason" to force one. Read live from GitHub — no deploy needed. See docs/SEASON.md. free_until (YYYY-MM-DD): every Pro feature is free for everyone BEFORE this date; the paywall returns on it. Set it to a past date to end the free period.
